text: Good afternoon. I'm calling this meeting of the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee to order. This meeting is to hear one or more student discipline appeals. My name is Ms. Carrie Labelle, and I'm chairing this meeting. With me are Mrs. Anne Donahue and Mr. Ross Svenson. I would now like to call for a motion to move into closed session. Yes, Ms. Donahue. Thank you, Chair Labelle. I move that the Student Behavior and Accountability

Committee of Loudoun County School Board recess this public meeting and enter into a closed meeting pursuant to Section 2.2-3712 of the Code of Virginia for the following purpose: discussion or consideration of a recommendation for disciplining one or more students enrolled in Loudoun County Public Schools, as authorized by Section 2.2-3711 sub A sub 2 of the Code of Virginia. Thank you. Is there a second? Second. Thank you, Mr. Svenson. The motion's been seconded. All in favor say aye. Aye. Aye.

Any opposed? Seeing no opposition, we will move forward. This committee approves the motion to move into closed session by a vote of three to zero. And with no further business in front of us, I move that the closed meeting be adjourned and that the Student Behavior and Accountability of Loudoun County Public Schools reconvene in a public meeting, that the minutes of this public meeting reflect that no formal action was taken in the closed meeting. Is there a second?

Second. Thank you, Ms. Donahue. The motion has been seconded. All in favor say aye. Aye. Aye. Anyone against, say nay. Hearing no opposition, the committee approves the motion to adjourn the closed session by a vote of three to zero. Okay. We need to have a motion to certify the closed meeting. Who'd like to read that for me? I'm happy to do so.

Thank you, Mr. Svenson. I move that the following resolution certifying the closed meeting be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. Resolution number 08-26/27, whereas the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee of the Loudoun County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote and in accordance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act. And whereas Section 2.2-3712D of the Code of Virginia requires a

certification by this committee of the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law. Now, therefore, be it resolved that the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee of the Loudoun County School Board hereby certifies that to the best of each member's knowledge, one, only public business matters lawfully exempted from open meeting requirements by Virginia law were discussed in the executive meeting to which this certification applies. And two, only such public business matters that were identified in the motion

convening the closed meeting were heard, discussed, or considered by the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee of the Loudoun County School Board. Is there a second? Second. Thank you, Ms. Donahue. The motion has been seconded. All in favor say aye. Aye. Aye. Anyone against, say nay. Hearing no opposition, the committee approves the motion by a vote of three to zero to certify the closed session.
